name: Account Security Across Services
summary: Joins the login events of all jt- packs: password spraying spread over several services from one address, a successful login from an address that was spraying, one account failing on several services from several addresses, and a login on one service after another service locked the account or the address out. Quiet on a fresh install; needs the other packs.
summary_zh: 串接所有 jt- 套件的登入事件：同一位址把密碼噴灑分散到多個服務、正在噴灑的位址登入成功、同一帳號從多個位址在多個服務失敗，以及某服務鎖定帳號或位址後在另一個服務登入成功。新安裝即保持安靜；需要搭配其他套件。
author: Jason Tools
notes: What it detects. Every other jt- pack sees one product; this pack joins the login events of all of them. 132701 (level 10): one public address failed to log in at least three times within 10 minutes on more than one service or host, with account names other than the last one (password spraying spread over services so that no single service counts enough). 132702 (level 12): the same with six failures. 132704 (level 13): a successful login, on any service, from an address that 132701 or 132702 reported within 30 minutes. 132703 (level 10): one account name failed five times within 15 minutes on more than one service, from addresses other than the last one (distributed guessing). 132705 (level 12): an account that one service locked out logs in on another service from a public address other than the one in the lockout. 132706 (level 12): a login from an address that another service had just locked out.

The convention. The packs mark their login rules with three groups: jt_auth_success (one event per successful login of a named account), jt_auth_failure (one event per failed login: wrong password, unknown, disabled or locked account; a product that writes the same attempt twice tags one copy) and jt_auth_lockout (the product locked or throttled an account or address), with srcip the client address without ::ffff: and dstuser the account as the product writes it. Wazuh's own authentication_success group is not used for this: the built-in rules 17101 and 17102 hang under it and raise every login outside office hours to level 9. A new pack joins by adding these groups to its login rules; this pack needs no change.

It needs the other packs. Installed alone it loads and does nothing. Packs that follow the convention: jt-keycloak, jt-ucs, jt-opnsense, jt-nextcloud, jt-proxmox, jt-pbs, jt-pmg, jt-odoo, jt-synology, jt-librenms, jt-adguard and jt-ipam (each from its next patch release), jt-zimbra 3.3 and jt-zpush 1.3. The rule file is named zzzz- so that it loads after all of them: a rule only hangs under, and only counts, rules that were loaded before it. Install or update other packs, then reload the ruleset as usual. In a cluster each node correlates only the events it analyses: the services' agents must report to the same node to be joined.

What it can see. A failed login is counted as an earlier event only when the rule it ended on is not the target of another rule's if_matched_sid (Wazuh then keeps the event in that rule's own list and skips the group lists). Packs that count their failures with a pack-only group are fully visible: Keycloak, Samba AD and the UCS management console, OPNsense (web interface, services, OpenVPN), Proxmox VE, PMG, jt-ipam, Zimbra and Z-Push. Nextcloud, PBS, Synology, LibreNMS, Odoo and AdGuard still count with if_matched_sid on a failure rule that has several parent paths (where a group would count each event several times); their failures are seen when they happen, not afterwards. A rule with several parent paths is also stored once per path: one jt-ipam audit failure counts twice.

Why it is quiet by default, with no list to fill. Only public source addresses are used for the address-based rules: inside the network one address is often a reverse proxy, a NAT gateway, a vulnerability scanner or a server that checks passwords for others, and the per-pack rules already count internal addresses. Two copies of one login written by two products (Z-Push and Zimbra, a front end and its directory) share the account name and are not counted as spraying. A successful login alone is never an alert here. Measured on this project's site over eight days of alerts from both cluster nodes (10,938 failed logins: 7,394 from private addresses, 3,544 without an address, none from a public one; 12 successful logins from public addresses): the rules would have raised nothing. Counted the same way, private sources would have raised 5,163 alerts, almost all from one internal host trying SSH on many servers.

What it deliberately does not do. Accounts are joined by exact name, so alice, alice@example.com and EXAMPLE\alice are three accounts; mapping them would need site data. Internal sources are left to the per-pack rules. A phone with an old password keeps failing from one address; 132703 needs failures from other addresses on another service as well. A login followed by an administrator login or a credential change elsewhere (lateral account takeover) is not attempted: the packs mark administrator logins and credential changes with groups of their own, not with one shared group. No active response: a sprayed address is better blocked by each service's own lockout or by fail2ban, and two of the rules key on successful logins, which must never block the owner.

1.1: internal addresses trying logins on many hosts (132710-132720). The rules above ignore internal sources; these count them across hosts, because a compromised machine guessing passwords on its neighbours stays under every per-host brute-force rule (on one network a misconfigured tool made 8,856 failed SSH logins on 7 servers in a week, at most 6 per server in two minutes, and nothing above level 5 was raised). Ten failures on other hosts within 10 minutes is level 11, thirty level 12, a successful login from that address afterwards level 13. SSH, PAM and pack-tagged failures are counted, and Windows logon failures through the authentication_failed group so that the built-in 60204 and 40111 keep working; on a cluster each manager counts the agents connected to it. Addresses that relay other people's logins go in etc/lists/jt-account-guard-internal-ignore (ships with a documentation address only).

List keys. etc/lists/jt-account-guard-internal-ignore is looked up with not_address_match_key, which finds an address or an octet-boundary prefix (198.51.100. for a /24, 198.51. for a /16); a key written as a CIDR (198.51.100.0/24) is never found.
notes_zh: 偵測內容。其他 jt- 套件各自只看一個產品，本套件把所有套件的登入事件串起來。132701（等級 10）：同一個公開位址 10 分鐘內在一個以上的服務或主機登入失敗至少三次，而且帳號名稱與最後一次不同（把密碼噴灑分散到多個服務，讓每個服務都數不到門檻）。132702（等級 12）：同樣情形達六次。132704（等級 13）：132701 或 132702 在 30 分鐘內報過的位址，在任何服務登入成功。132703（等級 10）：同一個帳號名稱 15 分鐘內在一個以上的服務失敗五次，來源位址與最後一次不同（分散式猜密碼）。132705（等級 12）：某個服務鎖定了帳號，同一個帳號隨後從另一個公開位址在別的服務登入成功。132706（等級 12）：某個服務剛鎖定的位址，在別的服務登入成功。

約定。各套件在自己的登入規則加上三個群組：jt_auth_success（每一次具名帳號登入成功一筆）、jt_auth_failure（每一次登入失敗一筆：密碼錯誤、帳號不存在、停用或已鎖定；同一次嘗試記兩份的產品只標一份）、jt_auth_lockout（產品鎖定或節流了某個帳號或位址），srcip 是用戶端位址（不帶 ::ffff:），dstuser 是產品寫下的帳號。不使用 Wazuh 自己的 authentication_success 群組：內建規則 17101、17102 掛在它底下，會把上班時間以外的每一次登入升到等級 9。新的套件只要在登入規則加上這些群組就會被納入，本套件不必修改。

需要其他套件。單獨安裝時可以載入，但什麼都不做。遵守約定的套件：jt-keycloak、jt-ucs、jt-opnsense、jt-nextcloud、jt-proxmox、jt-pbs、jt-pmg、jt-odoo、jt-synology、jt-librenms、jt-adguard、jt-ipam（各自從下一個修補版起）、jt-zimbra 3.3 與 jt-zpush 1.3。規則檔名以 zzzz- 開頭，是為了在它們全部之後載入：規則只能掛在、也只會計算比它早載入的規則。安裝或更新其他套件後照常重新載入規則集即可。叢集中每個節點只關聯自己分析的事件：要被串接的服務，其 agent 必須連到同一個節點。

看得到什麼。登入失敗只有在它最後落在的規則不是其他規則 if_matched_sid 的目標時，才會被當成「之前的事件」計算（否則 Wazuh 只把事件放進那條規則自己的清單，跳過群組清單）。以套件專屬群組計算失敗的套件完全看得到：Keycloak、Samba AD 與 UCS 管理主控台、OPNsense（網頁介面、服務、OpenVPN）、Proxmox VE、PMG、jt-ipam、Zimbra 與 Z-Push。Nextcloud、PBS、Synology、LibreNMS、Odoo 與 AdGuard 的失敗規則有多條父規則路徑（改用群組會讓每筆事件被算好幾次），仍以 if_matched_sid 計算；它們的失敗在發生當下看得到，之後就看不到。有多條父規則路徑的規則也會依路徑各存一份：一筆 jt-ipam 稽核失敗會算兩次。

為什麼預設安靜、也不需要填清單。以位址為準的規則只看公開來源位址：內部網路裡一個位址常常是反向代理、NAT 閘道、弱點掃描器或替別人驗證密碼的伺服器，而各套件已經會依內部位址計算失敗。兩個產品對同一次登入各記一份（Z-Push 與 Zimbra、前端與它的目錄服務）時帳號相同，不會被算成噴灑。單純的登入成功在這裡從不告警。以本專案站台兩個叢集節點八天的告警量測（10,938 筆登入失敗：7,394 筆來自私有位址、3,544 筆沒有位址、沒有任何一筆來自公開位址；12 筆來自公開位址的成功登入）：這些規則一筆都不會產生。若同樣計算私有來源，會產生 5,163 筆，幾乎全部來自一台在許多伺服器嘗試 SSH 的內部主機。

刻意不做的事。帳號以完全相同的名稱比對，所以 alice、alice@example.com 與 EXAMPLE\alice 是三個帳號；要對應它們需要站台資料。內部來源交給各套件的規則。用舊密碼的手機會一直從同一個位址失敗；132703 還需要其他位址在另一個服務的失敗。登入後在別處進行管理員登入或變更憑證（橫向帳號接管）沒有實作：各套件用各自的群組標示管理員登入與憑證變更，沒有共用的群組。沒有主動回應：被噴灑的位址交給各服務自己的鎖定或 fail2ban 封鎖比較好，而且其中兩條規則以成功登入為準，絕不能因此封鎖帳號本人。

1.1：內部位址在多台主機上試登入（132710-132720）。上面的規則刻意忽略內部來源；這些規則跨主機累計，因為被入侵的機器對鄰近主機猜密碼時，每一台都不會超過單機的暴力破解門檻（在某個網路上，一個設定錯誤的工具一週對 7 台伺服器失敗 8,856 次，每台兩分鐘內最多 6 次，從未出現高於 level 5 的告警）。10 分鐘內在其他主機失敗 10 次是 level 11、30 次 level 12，之後從該位址成功登入是 level 13。計入 SSH、PAM 與各套件標記的失敗；Windows 登入失敗經 authentication_failed 群組計數，讓內建 60204 與 40111 仍然有效；叢集上每台 manager 各自計算連到它的 agent。替別人轉送登入的位址列在 etc/lists/jt-account-guard-internal-ignore（出廠只有一個文件用位址）。
清單鍵值。etc/lists/jt-account-guard-internal-ignore 以 not_address_match_key 查詢，只認得完整位址或以八位元組為界的前綴（/24 寫成 198.51.100.、/16 寫成 198.51.）；寫成 CIDR（198.51.100.0/24）的鍵永遠找不到。

setup.title: Install and reload the ruleset on every node
setup.title_zh: 安裝並在所有節點重新載入規則集
setup.body:
1. Install from this page.
2. On the Rules tab press Reload ruleset. The cluster copies rule files to the workers but does not reload them.
setup.body_zh:
1. 在本頁安裝。
2. 到「規則」分頁按「重新載入規則集」。叢集會把規則檔複製到 worker，但不會替它們重載。
setup.verify: On every node, /var/ossec/bin/wazuh-analysisd -t prints no WARNING line.
setup.verify_zh: 在每個節點上，/var/ossec/bin/wazuh-analysisd -t 不印出任何 WARNING。

setup.title: Update the packs whose logins it joins
setup.body: Install or update the other jt- packs to a release that tags its logins with jt_auth_success, jt_auth_failure and jt_auth_lockout (for example jt-keycloak 1.2.1, jt-ucs 1.2.1, jt-opnsense 1.2.1, jt-nextcloud 1.2.1, jt-zimbra 3.3, jt-zpush 1.3). Reload the ruleset after every pack install or update: the rules attach when the ruleset loads.
setup.body_zh: 把其他 jt- 套件安裝或更新到登入規則帶有 jt_auth_success、jt_auth_failure、jt_auth_lockout 群組的版本（例如 jt-keycloak 1.2.1、jt-ucs 1.2.1、jt-opnsense 1.2.1、jt-nextcloud 1.2.1、jt-zimbra 3.3、jt-zpush 1.3）。每次安裝或更新套件後都要重新載入規則集：規則是在載入規則集時掛上的。
setup.verify: In the Rules tab, the hierarchy for 132701 shows it under the failed-login rules of the installed packs (for example 131341 of jt-keycloak).
setup.verify_zh: 在「規則」分頁的階層檢視中，132701 會出現在已安裝套件的登入失敗規則底下（例如 jt-keycloak 的 131341）。

setup.title: Log the real client address in each product
setup.title_zh: 讓各產品記錄真正的用戶端位址
setup.body: Behind a reverse proxy, set each product to log the forwarded client address (Nextcloud trusted_proxies, Keycloak proxy headers, Zimbra zimbraMailTrustedIP, Odoo proxy_mode). Otherwise its logins carry the proxy's internal address and are left out. Trust forwarded headers only from your own proxy, or a client can choose the address it is logged under.
setup.body_zh: 在反向代理後面，請讓每個產品記錄轉送過來的用戶端位址（Nextcloud 的 trusted_proxies、Keycloak 的 proxy 標頭設定、Zimbra 的 zimbraMailTrustedIP、Odoo 的 proxy_mode）。否則該產品的登入都帶著代理的內部位址而被略過。只信任來自自家代理的轉送標頭，否則用戶端可以自己決定被記錄成哪個位址。

setup.title: List internal addresses that relay others' logins
setup.title_zh: 列出替別人轉送登入的內部位址
setup.body:
1. Add each reverse proxy, NAT gateway or server that checks passwords for others to etc/lists/jt-account-guard-internal-ignore, one per line: an address as 192.0.2.10: or a whole /24 as 198.51.100.: (a key written as a CIDR never matches).
2. Reload the ruleset. On a node the install could not reach, first add the <list> line inside <ruleset> of ossec.conf.
3. Before enabling a blocking response, add the manager, gateways, DNS servers, jump hosts and administrators' machines to <white_list> in ossec.conf.
setup.body_zh:
1. 把每台反向代理、NAT 閘道，或替別人檢查密碼的伺服器加進 etc/lists/jt-account-guard-internal-ignore，一行一個：單一位址寫成 192.0.2.10:，整個 /24 寫成 198.51.100.:（寫成 CIDR 的鍵永遠比對不到）。
2. 重新載入規則集。安裝時連不到的節點，先在 ossec.conf 的 <ruleset> 內加上 <list> 這一行。
3. 啟用封鎖之前，把 manager、閘道、DNS、跳板機與管理者的電腦加進 ossec.conf 的 <white_list>。
setup.verify: After the reload, wazuh-analysisd -t prints no warning 7616 (a list that is not declared).
setup.verify_zh: 重新載入後，wazuh-analysisd -t 不出現警告 7616（清單未宣告）。

active_response.title: Block an internal address that guesses logins on many hosts (Linux agents)
active_response.title_zh: 封鎖在多台主機猜登入的內部位址（Linux agent）
active_response.body: When an internal address reaches 30 failed logins on several hosts within 10 minutes (SSH 132711 and 132713, PAM 132715, pack-tagged services 132719), or logs in after doing so (132720), every Linux agent drops that address with iptables or nftables for 30 minutes. The level 10 rules do not block. Windows-only guessing (132716, 132717) carries the address in a Windows field, not in srcip, so it cannot trigger a block. Risks: blocking an internal address on every agent cuts that machine off from all monitored hosts for 30 minutes; if it is a legitimate tool with a wrong password (a backup or monitoring job), the block stops it until the timeout. A relay address that is not in the ignore list would block every user behind it. Addresses in <white_list> are never blocked. Changes to responses take effect after the managers restart.
active_response.body_zh: 內部位址 10 分鐘內在多台主機登入失敗達 30 次時（SSH 132711、132713，PAM 132715，各套件標記的服務 132719），或之後登入成功時（132720），每個 Linux agent 以 iptables 或 nftables 封鎖該位址 30 分鐘。level 10 的規則不會觸發封鎖。只針對 Windows 的猜測（132716、132717）把位址記在 Windows 欄位而不是 srcip，無法觸發封鎖。 風險：在每個 agent 上封鎖一個內部位址，會讓那台機器 30 分鐘內連不到任何受監控的主機；若它是帳密設錯的正當工具（備份或監控排程），封鎖會讓它停到逾時為止。沒列入例外清單的轉送位址，會連帶擋掉它後面的所有使用者。<white_list> 裡的位址永遠不會被封鎖。回應的變更要在 manager 重啟後才生效。

active_response.title: Block an internal address that guesses logins on many hosts (Windows agents)
active_response.title_zh: 封鎖在多台主機猜登入的內部位址（Windows agent）
active_response.body: The same triggers as the Linux response, applied on Windows agents with a Windows Firewall rule (netsh) for 30 minutes. Enable both to block the address on every host. Risks: blocking an internal address on every agent cuts that machine off from all monitored hosts for 30 minutes; if it is a legitimate tool with a wrong password (a backup or monitoring job), the block stops it until the timeout. A relay address that is not in the ignore list would block every user behind it. Addresses in <white_list> are never blocked. Changes to responses take effect after the managers restart.
active_response.body_zh: 觸發條件與 Linux 版相同，在 Windows agent 上以 Windows 防火牆規則（netsh）封鎖 30 分鐘。兩個都啟用，才會在所有主機上封鎖。 風險：在每個 agent 上封鎖一個內部位址，會讓那台機器 30 分鐘內連不到任何受監控的主機；若它是帳密設錯的正當工具（備份或監控排程），封鎖會讓它停到逾時為止。沒列入例外清單的轉送位址，會連帶擋掉它後面的所有使用者。<white_list> 裡的位址永遠不會被封鎖。回應的變更要在 manager 重啟後才生效。
